The Friars, led by third-year head coach [[Ed Cooley]], played their home games at the [[Dunkin' Donuts Center]], and were in their first season as members of the reorganized [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 23–12, 10–8 in Big East play to finish in a three-way tie for third place. They were champions of the [[2014 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to earn the conference's automatic bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA
